stemMd: Which of these oxides reacts with water to give a basic (alkaline) solution?
explanationMd:
Look at which element the oxygen is bonded to. Oxides of **metals** from the far left of the periodic table (groups 1 and 2) are basic: they react with water to give a hydroxide. Oxides of **non-metals** are acidic: they react with water to give an acid.

$$\mathrm{Na_2O + H_2O \rightarrow 2\,NaOH}$$

The other four are all non-metal oxides:

$$\mathrm{SO_3 + H_2O \rightarrow H_2SO_4}\qquad \mathrm{CO_2 + H_2O \rightleftharpoons H_2CO_3}$$

$$\mathrm{N_2O_5 + H_2O \rightarrow 2\,HNO_3}\qquad \mathrm{SO_2 + H_2O \rightleftharpoons H_2SO_3}$$

**Check:** only one metal appears among the five formulas. Sodium hydroxide, the product, is a strong base, so the solution is alkaline.

distractorRationale.c: Sulfur trioxide is the oxide of a non-metal. It adds to water to give sulfuric acid, $\mathrm{H_2SO_4}$, a strong acid.
distractorRationale.a: Carbon dioxide is a non-metal oxide. It dissolves in water to give carbonic acid, $\mathrm{H_2CO_3}$, so the solution is slightly acidic, never basic.
distractorRationale.e: Dinitrogen pentoxide is a non-metal oxide. It gives nitric acid, $\mathrm{HNO_3}$, on reaction with water.
distractorRationale.d: Sulfur dioxide is a non-metal oxide. With water it forms sulfurous acid, $\mathrm{H_2SO_3}$, which is acidic.

accessibilityText: The question asks which oxide gives a basic solution with water. The oxides are sulfur trioxide, S O subscript 3; carbon dioxide, C O subscript 2; sodium oxide, Na subscript 2 O; dinitrogen pentoxide, N subscript 2 O subscript 5; and sulfur dioxide, S O subscript 2.

independentSolve.workingNotes: Na2O is a metal oxide and gives 2 NaOH with water. CO2, SO3, SO2 and N2O5 are all acidic non-metal oxides. [A second, separate blind solve (blind-reviewer-wave6-tolcf-chem-run18) reached the same answer: Na2O is a metal oxide and reacts with water to give NaOH, which is basic. CO2, SO3, SO2 and N2O5 are all acidic non-metal oxides.]

review.notes: Awaiting a blind independent solve before publication. Key check: Na2O + H2O gives 2 NaOH; SO3, CO2, N2O5 and SO2 are non-metal oxides giving H2SO4, H2CO3, HNO3 and H2SO3. Options were reordered after review to remove answer-position bias; ids and labels were remapped with the key.
